note: v: true = yes, false = no, null = not confirmed. 'why' and 'src' are for Jasper's review only; the build never prints them on a page. 'old Buoy data' means the answer comes from the previous site's services.json, not from a page read on the checked date. 'say' is the one short line shown under an answer on the comparison page; keep the same words for the same fact across services.
